title: Every frozen selection disposition is true - the leadership floor is the only inclusion gate (37/539 frontier rows mislabeled today)

target.surface: GET /api/compass -> manifest selection block + comparison_cohort selection_disposition; / Next-session focus + manifest strip
target.subject: app.engine.compass.evaluate_selection candidacy gating vs the disposition vocabulary

evidence.artifact: apps/backend/data/exports/next_session_manifests/2026-08-12_v7.json (committed at-ingest export, frontier as_of = the default / view)
evidence.measured: 37 of 539 comparison_cohort rows carry leadership_score >= compass.selection.leadership_min_score (80.0) - max 92.71 (HPE, leadership_bucket A, rank_in_run 1) - yet ALL 37 are frozen with selection_disposition 'below_selection_floor'; disposition_tally = {below_selection_floor: 539, excluded_by_cap: 0}
evidence.cause: apps/backend/app/engine/compass.py:619-633 - _qualifier_checks returns three checks and evaluate_selection admits a member only `if all(check['passed'] ...)`, so entry_min_score and risk_max_score GATE inclusion; every non-qualifying row is then stamped _DISPOSITION_BELOW_FLOOR (compass.py:666) regardless of which check failed
evidence.contract_violated: docs/goal.md Improvement direction: the frozen rule is 'floor -> deterministic order -> cap; nothing else excludes'; 'below_selection_floor' is DEFINED as 'leadership below leadership_min_score'; 'qualifiers annotate cautions and never gate inclusion today'. J-06 counter-test: 'changing ... a caution qualifier moves neither scientific hash nor any membership' - currently FALSE (changing entry_min_score moves candidate membership).
evidence.why_tests_miss_it: apps/backend/tests/test_compass.py:90 fixture's only qualifier-failing row (CCC, L=77) is ALSO below the 80 floor, so no test exercises an above-floor qualifier-failing member; test_manifest_invariants.py:778 test_tc23_why_not_and_qualifier_changes_move_only_manifest_config_hash perturbs why_not_cap ONLY - it never perturbs a qualifier and never asserts the 'nor any membership' half
evidence.post_fix_arithmetic: 37 above-floor names -> top 10 candidates (HPE, GRMN, NTAP, ABNB, DELL, CRL, LH, MPC, VRTX, PANW) + 27 excluded_by_cap + 502 below_selection_floor; 502 + 27 = 529 = 539 - 10 (partition holds); shadow band [75.0, 80.0) stays exactly the 25 rows it is today (no cohort_rule_hash semantics move)

rationale: The cycle's flagship artifact - the immutable, hash-covered, exported Tapeology handoff - carries a factually false label on 6.9% of its comparison cohort, including the run's rank-1 name at leadership 92.71. A downstream consumer filtering 'below_selection_floor' would conclude these names had weak leadership; the opposite is true. The remedy is prescribed by goal.md itself (conform the code to the documented one-gate rule; qualifiers annotate cautions), needs NO schema change (the committed schema's selection_disposition enum stays two-member), NO new Data Contract value, NO threshold retuning, and makes J-06's half-implemented counter-test true for the first time. Promoted to J-12.

consistency.contract_note: state/blueprint.md gets a dated note on the existing Next-session manifest CONTENT / FREEZE-INTEGRITY rows recording the compass.selection.rule_version bump and the truthful-disposition invariant

excludes: any change to a threshold VALUE (leadership_min_score / entry_min_score / risk_max_score / max_candidates stay exactly as configured - AG-15)
any mutation, relabeling, rehash or deletion of an already-frozen manifest row or export file (AG-12/AG-17)
adding a disposition vocabulary member or a new versioned schema file (the alternative remedy - see the excluded_by_qualifier backlog line)
any new composite / blended candidate number (AG-11)

title: Leadership rotation says which way, covers both directions, and stops repeating What-changed

target.subject: session_delta rotation block (group-level, direction-balanced) + signed delta/direction_word on change entries

vision_gap: docs/goal.md Vision: '... where leadership is rotating ...'; Success Criteria: 'From / alone ... the top sector/theme movers IN BOTH DIRECTIONS'; Key Capabilities #1 lists 'leadership rotation' as part of the Today compass. NO Must-have journey asserts the rotation section's CONTENT - J-07 step 1 asserts only that the section renders in page order.

evidence.duplication: apps/frontend/components/compass-leadership-rotation-section.tsx renders compass.session_delta.changes.filter(kind in {sector,theme,stock}) - a client-side subset of the SAME array compass-whatchanged-card.tsx renders in FULL. On the frontier manifest 2026-08-12_v7.json, changes = 17 entries (5 sector, 2 theme, 10 stock, 0 market, 0 breadth), so the rotation section repeats all 17 rows the card directly above it already showed - a 100% duplicate on the default landing view.
evidence.no_direction: A change entry is {from, to, magnitude} with an UNSIGNED magnitude and no direction field (verified in the export). 'Home Construction (iShares) 21 -> 25' (worse) and 'Regional Banks (SPDR) 13 -> 10' (better) are visually identical; the reader must know that a lower rank number is better and that leadership bucket E -> D is an improvement. The iter-28 state_band block already established the correct served shape {delta: signed, direction_word: from compass.vocabulary.direction_words} - the change entries never got it.
evidence.both_directions_not_guaranteed: session_delta.py:131-133 / :161-162 sort by abs(rank move) then cut changes[:compass.delta.top_k] (5), so one direction can be cut away entirely; both sides appear today only by luck.
evidence.silent_top_k_drop: _sector_changes/_theme_changes return changes[:top_k] but the FULL suppressed list, so an above-threshold mover ranked beyond top_k is dropped from `changes` AND never counted in `suppressed`. Measured on the frontier: theme accounts for 2 + 9 = 11 of 11 rows, but sector accounts for only 5 + 24 = 29 of the 31 configured sector/industry ETFs (config.etfs.sector 11 + industry 20) - 2 sector rows unaccounted for, consistent with the top_k overflow being silently dropped while 'Suppressed moves (36)' claims to disclose what was held back.

rationale: The one Vision claim with no journey behind it is also the one surface that adds no information: a filtered copy of the list above it, with no direction, no both-sides guarantee, and a silent top_k drop that the suppressed disclosure does not cover. Fix is lean and precedented: one served session_delta.rotation block from the SAME producer/endpoint (iter-28 state_band precedent), direction words from the EXISTING vocabulary map, one new config-only display cap, no schema change (session_delta is an open object in the committed schema), What-changed left byte-identical so J-02 stays green. Promoted to J-13.

consistency.new_contract_value: session_delta.rotation (group-level, direction-labeled) + signed delta/direction_word on session_delta change entries - registered as added fields of the existing 'Next-session manifest - CONTENT block' Data Contract row in state/blueprint.md, exactly as iter-28 registered state_band
consistency.word_map: reuses compass.vocabulary.direction_words (up/down/flat) - never a second word map

excludes: moving sector/theme rows OUT of the What-changed card (would break J-02's market -> breadth -> sectors -> themes -> stocks page-order assertion)
any stock-level rotation / weakness view (goal.md Non-Goals: group-level weakening deltas only)
retuning rank_move_min or any existing compass.delta threshold (AG-15 hygiene)
changing the AG-8 max_stock_items bound or its accounting (separate backlog line)
any new composite or blended rotation score (AG-11)

title: Add an 'excluded_by_qualifier' disposition instead of conforming the rule - ALTERNATIVE REMEDY, NOT PROMOTED (owner-governed: needs a new versioned schema file + a rule-scope change)
rationale: The other admissible fix for the J-12 defect: keep all three checks gating and make the LABEL honest by extending the closed vocabulary with a third member. Recorded, NOT promoted, because it is strictly heavier and touches owner-level contracts: the committed schema pins selection_disposition to enum ['below_selection_floor','excluded_by_cap'], and goal.md requires a schema change to be a NEW versioned file (never an in-place edit) plus a schema_version bump; goal.md also requires that when a qualifier becomes gating 'the vocabulary and the candidate-rule scope must extend together (rule_version bump)', which moves entry_min_score/risk_max_score into candidate_rule_hash's scope and contradicts J-06's stated counter-test that a caution qualifier moves neither scientific hash. J-12's remedy needs none of that. If the owner prefers three gates, this is the path - and it is a goal.md amendment, not proposer-autonomous work.

title: Account for the AG-8 stock-kind max_stock_items drop the way J-13 accounts for the sector/theme top_k drop - NOT PROMOTED (keep J-13 small)
rationale: session_delta._stock_changes applies the max_stock_items bound BEFORE _classify (session_delta.py:207-214), so leadership-bucket crossings beyond the bound enter neither `changes` nor `suppressed`. The frontier manifest shows exactly 10 stock changes = max_stock_items, so crossings were probably dropped uncounted. Unlike the sector/theme top_k drop this bound is a DOCUMENTED AG-8 protection ('never evaluates, ranks, or displays the full ~500+ member universe in one pass'), so the fix is a disclosure ('N further crossings not shown'), not a widened read - and folding it into J-13 would grow that journey past the one-surface size the guidance asks for. Held for a later cycle.
